messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tell your healthcare provider about severe pain, swelling, or skin changes.
These symptoms occur where the injection was given.
In rare cases, the injection has caused serious damage to the surrounding tissue.
The damage included tissue death (necrosis) and gangrene.
The damage has needed surgery to treat.
This is not a complete list of side effects.
Others may happen.
Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects.
You may report side effects to the FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.
Triplet: ["hydroxyzine", "has side effect location", "injection site"]

The relation 'has side effect location' in the triplet is defined as 'The adverse effect caused by the subject drug occurs at the location specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has severity': The medical condition or effect specified by the subject has the severity specified by the object entity.
B. None of the above.

Answer:
